# Originary

Originary helps teams issue and verify portable signed records for machine actions.

Last updated: 2026-05-19

Company: Poem, Inc.
Location: Delaware, USA
Contact: contact@originary.xyz

## What it is

Portable verification for API, MCP, agent, gateway, payment, and provisioning workflows.

Originary helps teams create signed records so another party can verify what happened without internal logs, dashboard access, or vendor runtime.

## Open protocol

PEAC Protocol is open-source software for portable signed interaction records, published and maintained by Originary.

- https://github.com/peacprotocol/peac

## Notes

Originary does not replace gateways, observability, payment rails, policy engines, or runtimes. It records selected facts so another party can verify what happened later.
